post_caption: You chose A: he pulled the cord. Bad idea? Part 2

beats.title: Pull the cord
beats.subtitle: PART 2
beats.say: You chose A. He pulls the cord.
The bus stops. The sign says: Home.
But you never told anyone where you live.

beats.text: Never get off at a stop that knows you
beats.say: On the back of the card... a fourth rule. Never get off at a stop that knows you.

messages.text: come in, I left the door open

beats.say: Mom texts. She can see the bus outside. The door is open.
But your house is forty minutes away.
The driver whispers. Your stop, Mark.
Through the bus door, you see your front door. Someone is standing behind it.
And the voice calling you inside... is yours.

beats.question: Step off the bus or tell the driver your real name?
beats.b: Tell the driver your real name
beats.say: Step off the bus? Or tell the driver your real name? Comment A or B.
